public_rationale: The broad deterioration claim is not established by the records reviewed. Microsoft reports nearly halving GPU dock-to-live times in its largest regions, which points in the opposite direction for one deployment stage. That does not resolve the whole industry or the time from initial spending to operation. Accounting ratios and asset balances do not supply the missing comparable commissioning history.
limitations: The direct operational evidence covers one company and one deployment stage.
Different readings of conversion efficiency could produce different results.

The endpoint is the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the latest completed reporting quarter publicly reportable before the post.
The historical baseline is unspecified and remains open rather than being selected to fit the evidence.
A falling D&A-to-capex ratio is a proposed proxy, not the outcome itself.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable historical spending cohorts show a broad deterioration in commissioning time or the share operational at a fixed age, after accounting for asset mix and cost changes.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records show stable or improving conversion across the group. An improvement at one company is material counterevidence but does not settle a group-level trend.
